scope: GLOBAL-Q finite development instrument; not independent certification
search_proposal: Q2-ONE: every optimum source quotient with b edges has one edge whose deletion leaves at most floor(b/2) optimum residual edges in each component
failure_condition: An exact original optimum K with no such quotient edge kills Q2-ONE only; it does not refute safe-cover existence or one-optimum coverage.
